title: Chest Frame+
description: Shows chest contents on the outside using phantom item frames, so you can see what's inside without opening it.
body:
# Chest Frame+
**Chest Frame+** is a client mod for Fabric that shows the contents of chests directly on their faces through "phantom" frames. Without installing vanilla frames, without unnecessary blocks — just a visual hint of what lies inside.

A simple modification that makes viewing the contents of the chest much more convenient, adding new functionality to the familiar framework.

![How to works](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a43c05222c1e9271626162b991447e5c82972c3.jpeg)

### The **J** key in the world is the settings menu (or the button in the Mod Menu):

- turning on/off the mod
- face selection: front, back, left, right
- frame style: regular, luminous, transparent, stone, ender, hologram
- Item sorting: first slot or maximum number
- display of the number of items on the frame
- fine-tuning the frame position (offset, rotation, scale) for single and double chests
